_source: Actions from NASA TSS2027 documents/telemetry_ranges/eva-telemetry-ranges.pdf (the notes column) and docs/plan/milestones/M2-telemetry-alerts.md. Grouping per problem: decision D in docs/briefs/M2.md.
_how_it_works: One alert per problem. A rule's values are checked with data/ranges.json: the alert rises after 2 new telemetry samples off nominal and clears after 3 nominal ones. A rule's fault flag raises a warning at once and clears on the first all-clear. Severity is the worst of the inputs. A value with 'switch' watches only the device the DCU switch selects (by_position maps each switch position to a value). Every ranged value that no rule names gets its own alert with the generic action. Link and data alerts are not suit alerts: they show even before the EVA starts.
